A new Laurent coefficient 1_{t>k}(t-k)^q u^(-k-1)/(pi Gamma(q)) yields qth jump and all lower derivatives continuous. Independently rebuilt symbolic E_q for q=1..8, Euler boundary/reciprocal identities and exact rational Sturm physical counts for alpha=1/3,1/2,3/4,1. This is not a proof merely from finite q checks.
